title: Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act, 2005
titleHi: महात्मा गांधी राष्ट्रीय ग्रामीण रोजगार गारंटी अधिनियम, 2005
sourceNote: Official (India Code / Ministry of Rural Development). The Act provides the statutory framework for guaranteed rural wage employment.

title: Framework for Implementation of Pradhan Mantri Awaas Yojana-Gramin (PMAY-G)
titleHi: प्रधानमंत्री आवास योजना-ग्रामीण के क्रियान्वयन हेतु रूपरेखा
sourceNote: Official (PMAY-G / Ministry of Rural Development). The 2022 Framework for Implementation is the official implementation framework; the PMAY-G programme has subsequently been continued through FY 2028-29, but the framework remains the principal implementation document located in the official repository.

title: National Rural Livelihoods Mission — Framework for Implementation
titleHi: राष्ट्रीय ग्रामीण आजीविका मिशन — क्रियान्वयन हेतु रूपरेखा
sourceNote: Official (Aajeevika / Ministry of Rural Development). The framework was approved by the Ministry on 9 December 2010 and formed the implementation framework for NRLM, subsequently renamed DAY-NRLM.

title: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN) Scheme — Revised Operational Guidelines
titleHi: प्रधानमंत्री किसान सम्मान निधि योजना — संशोधित परिचालन दिशानिर्देश
sourceNote: Official (PM-KISAN / Department of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare). The official PM-KISAN site identifies this as the Revised Operational Guidelines, revised as on 29 March 2020; the site was last updated 17 February 2026.

title: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana — Operational Guidelines
titleHi: प्रधानमंत्री फसल बीमा योजना — परिचालन दिशानिर्देश
sourceNote: Official (PMFBY / Department of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare). The current PMFBY government portal specifically lists the '2023 Operational Guidelines of Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana' under its current documents.

title: Swachh Bharat Mission (Grameen) — Phase II Operational Guidelines
titleHi: स्वच्छ भारत मिशन (ग्रामीण) — चरण-II परिचालन दिशानिर्देश
department: Department of Drinking Water and Sanitation, Ministry of Jal Shakti
edition: Phase II Operational Guidelines, 2020, with subsequent amendments/clarifications listed on the official repository
sourceNote: Official (Department of Drinking Water and Sanitation). The official SBM-G guidelines repository lists the Phase-II Operational Guidelines and subsequent amendments/clarifications, including amendments to funding provisions and ODF Plus criteria.
